description: The file defines the HomeFragment class for an Android TV app, implementing the main home screen UI with hero carousel, continue watching, and TV channels sections. It manages focus navigation, auto-scrolling behavior, and data binding with ViewModel.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Main fragment class for the Android TV home screen, managing UI components, focus navigation, auto-scroll, and ViewModel interaction.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the repository and ViewModel for the fragment.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Constructs the view hierarchy programmatically, including the root ScrollView, top navigation bar, hero carousel, and sections for 'Continue Watching' and 'TV Channels'.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets initial focus, observes ViewModel states, and triggers data loading.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Resumes auto-scrolling behavior and focus management.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Pauses auto-scroll and focus animations.

methods.name: observeViewModelStates
methods.description: Sets up LiveData observers for UI state updates.

methods.name: showContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Displays loading UI for the 'Continue Watching' section.

methods.name: hideContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Hides the loading UI for the 'Continue Watching' section.

methods.name: showTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Displays loading UI for the 'TV Channels' section.

methods.name: hideTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Hides the loading UI for the 'TV Channels' section.

methods.name: showErrorWithRetry
methods.description: Displays error message with a retry option.

methods.name: updateContinueWatchingRail
methods.description: Populates the 'Continue Watching' rail with data, managing focus routing and key events.

methods.name: updateTvChannelsRail
methods.description: Populates the TV channels rail with data.

methods.name: addComposeTopNavBar
methods.description: Adds the Compose-based top navigation bar.

methods.name: setupHeroBanner
methods.description: Sets up the hero carousel with auto-scroll, focus handling, and layout adjustments.

methods.name: centerHeroAt
methods.description: Centers the hero carousel at a specified index with optional animation.

methods.name: pauseAutoScrollForUserInteraction
methods.description: Pauses the auto-scrolling when user interacts with the hero carousel.

methods.name: startHeroAutoScroll
methods.description: Starts the automatic scrolling of the hero carousel.

methods.name: stopHeroAutoScroll
methods.description: Stops the auto-scrolling of the hero carousel.

methods.name: setupContinueWatchingSection
methods.description: Creates the 'Continue Watching' section UI components.

methods.name: setupTvChannelsSection
methods.description: Creates the 'TV Channels' section UI components.

methods.name: setRailsFocusable
methods.description: Enables or disables focus for the rails.

methods.name: dpToPx
methods.description: Converts density-independent pixels to pixels.
